name: Local SEO Lesson - Module 10 Online Reviews and Reputation Management
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
A sustainable, policy-compliant review system. Notably, this module says never buy or incentivize reviews, which contradicts the shorter "5 star reviews" lesson.

# Key points
- Reviews affect both rankings (quantity, velocity, diversity) and conversions (92% of consumers read reviews, per the lesson).
- Focus on Google first, then one or two platforms that matter for the niche (Yelp, Facebook, Angi, industry sites). Yelp discourages directly asking for reviews.
- Ask soon after the service with a direct review link (from the GBP dashboard), email/SMS templates and QR cards.
- Respond to every review; for negatives, apologize where appropriate, address the issue and take it offline.
- Monitor continuously; share good reviews as testimonials with permission; a few 4-star reviews look more credible than all 5s.

# Steps
Get the review link, write a request template, build the ask into the workflow, monitor and respond every few days, expand to a second platform, showcase reviews.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- This is the version TAG follows. Review replies on GBP are Kim's or Scott's action, not Claude's.
- See [Local SEO Lesson - Getting Only 5 Star Reviews](lib:brain-local-seo-lesson-getting-only-5-star-reviews) for what not to do.
